description: This PHP source file contains a set of unit tests for the I18NService class within the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover various functionalities such as retrieving translation data, generating cache keys, and translating strings, specifically for the human resource management system's internationalization (i18n) component.

classes.name: I18NServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the I18NService class, testing functions related to translation retrieval, cache key generation, and language switching within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetI18NDao
methods.description: Verifies that the I18NService correctly returns an instance of I18NDao.

methods.name: testGetTranslator
methods.description: Tests obtaining a Translator object, ensuring correct locale and default behavior.

methods.name: testGetTranslationCollection
methods.description: Checks that the translation collection is correctly built from mocked translation data.

methods.name: testGenerateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of cache key prefix generation based on language code.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Validates the generated cache key for translation.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Checks cache key generation for translation key-target array.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Tests cache key generation for source-target array.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the ETag value for a given language code, ensuring caching works.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCodeWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Checks ETag retrieval when switching between multiple languages.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization of translation messages for a language.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Checks the array of translation key to target translations.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Tests cache fallback behavior when cache is cleared.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Tests cache fallback for source-target array.

methods.name: testTrans
methods.description: Tests the translation function with various message keys and parameters, including fallback behavior.

methods.name: testTransWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Assesses translation switching with multiple language codes.

methods.name: testTransBySource
methods.description: Checks translation of source strings directly to target language.

methods.name: getMockI18NDao
methods.description: Utility to create a mock I18NDao with predefined return values for testing.
